title: Release readiness checklist and turn-on order
description:
Write and keep in the repository the checklist that must be true before each thing is turned on in production, and the order: records and outcomes first (no behaviour change); the first agent at `observe` on one site; then `propose`; email in dry run with a test send before a live send; one site before the next; X last, with a watched first post. The checklist is in the architecture document (section 18); this task makes each line a named check or spec and records the evidence on the task.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Each checklist line names the spec or check that proves it.
- Nothing is turned on without its lines recorded as passed.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- (checklist; each line points at an existing feature file)

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Observability, safety and release readiness. Slice code J5 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
